asr.full_text: My name is Ryland and I'm a Vice President at JPMorgan Chase. I work in the line of business called Corporate Client Banking and Specialized Industries. We cover clients that are five hundred million in revenue to multi-billions in revenue. And basically we are the face of J.P. Morgan for our clients. We are tasked with owning every process. The client comes to us with a request. We then pull in the appropriate product partners and deliver the firm to our client. It's a great group. We've got great leadership. We've got a great culture. We have to sit down and look at every first year analyst across CCB. What's very unique about it from a junior banker perspective is that our line of business works very closely with the investment bank. So our analysts actually support not only the relationship side, the coverage bankers, but they also work with our Debt Capital Markets team, so you kind of get the best of both worlds. JPMorgan Chase has a culture, and it's a work-hard culture. It's a respect-each-other culture. It's a support our clients. It's a do-the-right-thing. It's everything that you hear J.B. Diamond say. He lives and breathes the culture and he inspires all of us. We have our summer analysts with us, a great attitude, great work ethic will bring and add value to the team. How did I get to where I am today in JPMorgan Chase? I would say working hard, contributing to the team, going above and beyond. And I'm a big, big, big, proponent of building strong relationships. We are making a difference in people's lives every single day. Instead of doing a food drive like we did last year, every market will basically plan kind of a big event for everyone to come together and volunteer. Part of our agenda is to set aside time to volunteer. That's a big part of our culture is giving back. We're all here to do a good job but there's more to life than than just that, right? I couldn't imagine working somewhere where that wasn't the case. It makes you want to be your best self. When you come into work. Our culture is very collaborative. We support each other. I mean, there are people on my team that I consider family. And if it weren't for the people, I don't think we could, you know, deliver to our clients the way we do. I think being able to sort of have that outside life makes And it will be worth it to me. I think that being able to have that outside life makes me a much happier person inside the office. At J.P. Morgan, I knew I'd be doing something meaningful.
